Index.meta_description: Compare real costs of CFDs, futures, ETFs and options based on your actual trading scenario. Free, no sign-up required.

TradeHero.title: See what trading really costs you
TradeHero.subtitle: Compare CFDs, futures, ETFs and options on the same underlying. Estimated real costs, not theoretical.
TradeHero.trust: Informational tool · Not financial advice · Data based on market averages

HowItWorks.title: Three steps to understand your real costs
HowItWorks.step1_desc: Choose asset, time horizon, capital, and leverage usage.
HowItWorks.step2_desc: We calculate spread, commissions, overnight, and estimated slippage for each instrument.
HowItWorks.step3_desc: Get a comparison table with total costs and operational efficiency index.

Compare.title: Same underlying, very different costs
Compare.intro: Each instrument has a different cost structure. The simulator normalises them to make them comparable.
Compare.etf_desc: Low management cost, no overnight. Ideal for medium-to-long horizons.
Compare.cfd_desc: Fast access with leverage, but spread and overnight swap can weigh on operations.
Compare.futures_desc: Regulated instrument, periodic rollover. Low costs at high volumes.
Compare.options_desc: Flexible payoff, but theta and commissions raise the effective cost.

OutputPreview.title: What you get from the simulation
OutputPreview.intro: Example scenario: €5,000 capital, intraday horizon, Nasdaq. Values are illustrative.
OutputPreview.table_note: Estimates based on average market conditions. Do not represent guaranteed costs.

WhyDifferent.title: Not a static comparator. A contextual simulation.
WhyDifferent.p1_desc: We don't show rate cards. We calculate costs in the context of your specific scenario.
WhyDifferent.p2_desc: CFDs, futures, ETFs and options on the same underlying, made comparable on an equal basis.
WhyDifferent.p3_desc: No recommendations. Only data to help you understand the cost structure.

Disclaimer.label: Disclaimer:
Disclaimer.text: The information provided is for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice, investment recommendation, or solicitation to buy or sell financial instruments. Values shown are estimates based on market averages and may differ from actual costs applied by individual brokers. You always operate at your own risk.

FAQ.answer1: A free tool to simulate and compare the real costs of different financial instruments based on your trading scenario.
FAQ.answer2: Yes, completely free. No sign-up required.

FAQ.answer5: CFDs, futures, ETFs and options. Same underlying, different cost structures.
